post.summary: Explain why a pathway ranks where it does
post.description:
Return a short narrative explaining the ranking of a single pathway.

Gemini's answer is numerically grounded against a FACTS dict built
server-side from the matching PathwayResult row.  If any number invented
by Gemini cannot be matched to FACTS within 1 %, the template is returned
instead.  API failures and missing keys also fall back to the template.

422.description: Pathway not found in the supplied results list.

post.description:
Run the LP allocation optimizer, then apply the Pareto filter.

Raises HTTP 422 if:
- The LP is infeasible (no valid allocation exists).
- Weight triplets in pareto_weight_sweep do not each sum to 1.0.
- Any key in compatibility_matrix or objective_coefficients is malformed.

Compute CRF-based annualised cost coefficients for a list of technologies.

Raises HTTP 422 if any technology parameter violates physical constraints
(e.g. capex < 0, throughput ≤ 0).

Compute itemized GHG delta for a proposed vs. baseline waste scenario.

Raises HTTP 422 if:
- IPCC boundary-matching rules are violated (BoundaryMismatchError).
- An unknown baseline_type or emission factor key is supplied.
- Any physical constraint on input values is violated.

Match a facility's product output to eligible buyers.

Raises HTTP 422 if:
- facility.available_volume ≤ 0.
- Any buyer bid_price < 0.
Identical requests return the same stored run (same id and audit_hash).

get.summary: Geocode a postal code to lat/lng
get.description:
Convert a postal code to approximate lat/lng coordinates via Nominatim.

For India the pincode must be exactly 6 digits and must not start with 0.
For other countries a non-empty alphanumeric string of at most 10 characters
is accepted.

Results are cached in memory (24 h TTL, up to 500 entries).  Outbound calls
are rate-limited to at most one per 1.1 s in compliance with Nominatim's
public-usage policy.

404.description: No result found for the given pincode and country.

503.description: Nominatim is unreachable, timed out, or returned an error.

farm_id.description: Unique identifier of the source farm / waste stream.

waste_tpd.description: Available waste feedstock in tonnes per day.

capex_inr.title: Capex Inr
capex_inr.description: Total capital expenditure in INR per pathway.

asset_life_yr.title: Asset Life Yr
asset_life_yr.description: Asset life in years per pathway (default: 20).

discount_rate.title: Discount Rate
discount_rate.description: Shared discount rate for CAPEX annualisation (default 7 %).

electricity_price_inr_kwh.title: Electricity Price Inr Kwh
electricity_price_inr_kwh.description: INR per kWh for electricity export (revenue) or import (cost).

gate_fee_inr_t.title: Gate Fee Inr T
gate_fee_inr_t.description: Tipping / gate fee received per tonne of waste (INR/tonne).

net_kwh_per_tonne.title: Net Kwh Per Tonne
net_kwh_per_tonne.description: Net kWh exported per tonne of waste processed (per pathway).

direct_ghg_kg_per_tonne.title: Direct Ghg Kg Per Tonne
direct_ghg_kg_per_tonne.description: Direct GHG emissions in kgCO2e per tonne processed.

capacity_tpd.title: Capacity Tpd
capacity_tpd.description: Maximum treatment capacity in tonnes/day per pathway.

mc_cost_cv.description: Coefficient of variation applied to annualised cost in MC runs.

mc_yield_cv.title: Mc Yield Cv

region.title: Region

location_id.title: Location Id

crop_type.title: Crop Type

warnings.title: Warnings

optimality_share.title: Optimality Share
optimality_share.description: Fraction of MC runs in which this pathway had the highest annual net value among deterministically feasible pathways.

win_count.title: Win Count

optimality_note.title: Optimality Note

Frontend contract — field names and types are fixed.

PathwayRowInput.title: PathwayRowInput
PathwayRowInput.description:
Minimal projection of a PathwayResult sufficient for the explain endpoint.

All fields are optional so the caller can pass the raw compare response
without filtering; unknown keys are ignored.

UncertaintyRequest.title: UncertaintyRequest
UncertaintyRequest.description:
Parameters for a Monte Carlo uncertainty run.

Attributes
----------
n:
    Number of Monte Carlo iterations [dimensionless]. Must be 10–20 000.
seed:
    Random seed for reproducibility.
distribution_overrides:
    Optional dict mapping Params field names to distribution-spec dicts.
    Each spec must have at least ``"kind"`` and ``"args"`` keys (matching
    the ``Dist`` dataclass in montecarlo.py). When None the engine uses
    ``montecarlo.default_dists()``.

UncertaintyResult.title: UncertaintyResult
UncertaintyResult.description: Mirrors the dict returned by montecarlo.run_mc().
